title: Welcome to the New KISWA Website
excerpt: We are proud to launch our new online home — a space built for our community, by our community.
content:
We are proud to welcome you to the new KISWA website — a digital home for our community, our stories, and our movement.

For over a decade, the Kisumu Sex Workers Alliance has stood at the frontlines of advocacy, health care access, and community empowerment across the Nyanza Region. Today, we take that fight online — bringing our voice, our programmes, and our resources to a wider audience.

What You'll Find Here

This website is your resource for everything KISWA:

  • About Us — learn about KISWA's history, vision, mission, and the values that drive us.
  • Programmes — explore the five strategic initiatives that shape our work on the ground.
  • Blog & Updates — stay informed about events, campaigns, and developments from our community.
  • Contact — reach us for support, partnership, or to get involved.

A Community Built on Love, Strength, and Care

KISWA was born out of crisis — but it has grown into something extraordinary. Today, we are a coalition of 22 registered sex worker-led groups across Kisumu, Siaya, Homa Bay, Migori, and Kisii. We are outlaws, lovers, and caregivers. We fight for rights, we share love, and we look out for each other — every step of the way.

"Alone we go faster, together we go further."

This website is another step forward — together. We invite you to explore, connect, and join the movement.

In solidarity and strength,
The KISWA Team
